facts.rationale: Documents actual float comparison and exceptional-value boundaries without asserting validated configuration.
facts.value: Increments the s32 yo-yo counter, calls YoyoSetUnkRate and YoyoCheckTimedRehit, then enters Release only if (float)yoyoCurrentFrame >= xAC_YOYO_CHARGE_DURATION. No local input or lifetime check occurs. For ordinary positive finite duration the inclusive threshold determines automatic release. With the normal reset counter, nonpositive duration or negative infinity releases on the first update; NaN or positive infinity does not satisfy the comparison for finite counters. Maintenance precedes the comparison, including the shared rate helper's unguarded division by duration when an item exists. There is no local signed-overflow or attribute-validation guard; A-release is handled by Charge_IASA.

facts.rationale: Corrects the implied transition-supersedes-completion guard and distinguishes creation failure from normal removal.
facts.value: Increments yoyoCurrentFrame before YoyoThink_IsRemove. A false helper result permits timed-rehit maintenance and, exactly at counter 13, charge entry when isChargeDisable is false and YoyoCheckNoObstruct succeeds. After any Charge_Enter call, control still evaluates ftAnim_IsFramesRemaining; false calls ft_8008A2BC. A true lifetime-helper result skips all those later operations. The reviewed helper returns true on failed item creation after calling ft_8008A2BC; normal scheduled item removal returns false.

facts.rationale: Makes frame domain, recursive blend and exceptional-coordinate qualifications explicit.
facts.value: After common ground physics, tests the integer yo-yo counter, not the animation-frame field. Below 19 it passes clamp(0.20000000298023224f * ((float)counter - 14.0f), 0, 1) to YoyoSetHitPosUnk and returns; at 19 or above it calls YoyoSetHitPos directly. Counters through 14 give zero weight and 15–18 give approximately 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8. The early helper blends the current target with the previously stored position on every invocation, not a fixed release origin. Zero weight preserves ordinary finite previous coordinates algebraically but does not suppress NaN/infinity propagation from target multiplication. The upper clamp is unreachable for ordinary valid s32 values in the <19 branch.
